Definition: Abel, the name of two places in Palestine.
BiblicalUsage: This is the name Abel on its own — the city in the north where Sheba flees and where Joab besieges him. The verse says Sheba 'went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel', and the wise woman reminds Joab that Abel was once the place where people said, 'They shall surely ask counsel at Abel.'
TheologicalSignificance: A city remembered for counsel and for one wise woman who stopped a siege with words. I believe Abel's story is a small sermon on wisdom: a city that asked counsel lived, and a woman who spoke well saved it — and that is a better defence than any wall.
